jobs.title: Senior Remediation Subject Matter Expert (SME)
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**  

AECOM is seeking a highly experienced **Senior Remediation Subject Matter Expert (SME)** to provide technical leadership and strategic guidance for complex environmental remediation projects supporting clients in the oil \& gas, refining, petrochemical, energy, and industrial sectors. This is a part\-time position designed for a recognized industry expert who will serve as a senior technical resource across multiple projects, supporting project delivery, mentoring technical staff, and helping clients develop innovative, cost\-effective remediation solutions.


The successful candidate will possess extensive experience with contaminated site investigation and remediation, regulatory compliance, remedial design, and closure strategies. This individual will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams while serving as a trusted advisor to clients and project managers.

**The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:**

* Serve as the senior technical lead and subject matter expert for environmental remediation projects involving soil, groundwater, sediment, and vapor impacts.
* Provide technical oversight and quality reviews for remedial investigations, feasibility studies, corrective action plans, remedial designs, risk assessments, remedial action implementation, and site closure documentation.
* Develop and review conceptual site models (CSMs), evaluate contaminant fate and transport, and recommend practical, technically sound remediation strategies.
* Provide technical expertise in the evaluation, selection, and optimization of remediation technologies, including:
* In\-situ Chemical Oxidation (ISCO)Soil Vapor Extraction (SVE)Air SpargingMulti\-Phase Extraction (MPE)BioremediationPump and Treat SystemsMonitored Natural Attenuation (MNA)Engineered containment systems
* Provide strategic guidance for projects regulated under RCRA Corrective Action, CERCLA/Superfund, Brownfields, UST/LUST, and state voluntary cleanup programs.
* Serve as a senior technical advisor during client meetings, regulatory discussions, and project planning activities.
* Mentor and provide technical leadership to project managers, engineers, geologists, hydrogeologists, and environmental scientists.
* Support business development efforts by contributing to technical proposals, scope development, project planning, and client presentations.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering and environmental teams to deliver innovative, practical, and cost\-effective solutions.
* Perform senior\-level technical reviews to ensure quality, consistency, regulatory compliance, and adherence to AECOM quality standards.
* Apply strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and technical writing skills while managing multiple priorities and supporting diverse project teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing and providing technical oversight for complex remediation projects supporting oil \& gas, refinery, petrochemical, industrial, manufacturing, or energy clients.
* Extensive knowledge of federal and state environmental regulations, including RCRA, CERCLA, UST/LUST programs, and Risk\-Based Corrective Action (RBCA).
* Demonstrated expertise in contaminated site investigation, remedial design, remedy optimization, and regulatory closure.
* Excellent technical writing, report review, presentation, and client communication skills.
* Proven ability to mentor technical staff and provide leadership across multidisciplinary project teams.

  

**Qualifications** **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Geological Engineering, Geology, Hydrogeology, Environmental Science, or a related field.
* 12\+ years of experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 20\+ years of progressively responsible environmental consulting experience with significant remediation expertise.
* Professional Engineer (PE) and/or Professional Geologist (PG) registration.
* Master's degree in Engineering, Hydrogeology, Environmental Science, Geology, or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting refinery, terminal, pipeline, and upstream or downstream oil \& gas remediation projects.
* Experience with groundwater modeling, contaminant transport modeling, and remedial system optimization.
* Recognized technical expert with an established reputation within the environmental consulting industry.
* Strong client relationship management and business development experience, including proposal preparation and strategic client support.

**Additional information**


This position does not provide employment visa sponsorship now or in the future. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship.


Employment is contingent upon successfully passing a pre\-employment drug screen.

**THIS POSITION IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY NOVEMBER 14, 2026\.**

jobs.title: Life Moments Remediation Lead - 6 months fixed term contract
jobs.description:
* REQ\-10119721
* 14/08/2026
* Business Control
* Sydney, Australia
* ING Bank


  
**Deliver Fair Outcomes for Customers**
---------------------------------------


At ING, customer outcomes are at the heart of everything we do. As part of our new Life Moments Transformation Program, we're strengthening our approach to supporting customers through complex life events and ensuring impacted customers receive fair, timely and consistent outcomes.


We're seeking a **Customer Remediation Lead** to lead the end\-to\-end remediation stream within the program. This **6 months fixed term contract** role has been established to ensure remediation activities are designed and executed effectively, meeting both customer expectations and regulatory requirements. Working across multiple teams, you'll help deliver outcomes that are fair, transparent and sustainable.


**Why Join the Life Moments Team?**
-----------------------------------


This is an opportunity to lead meaningful work that directly impacts customers while contributing to one of ING's most important customer outcome programs. You'll partner across Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Data and Technology, helping build stronger frameworks and better customer experiences.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Lead customer remediation activities from design through to execution
* Develop remediation methodologies, treatment approaches and governance materials
* Oversee customer impact assessments, calculations and payment execution
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Data and Technology teams
* Ensure remediation activities align with regulatory and internal framework requirements

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


* Experience leading customer remediation programs or customer outcome initiatives
* Strong understanding of conduct risk, remediation frameworks and governance
* Analytical capability and experience working with complex customer data
* Excellent judgement, stakeholder management and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to drive delivery in a highly regulated environment

**About Us**
  

  

At ING, we’re all about making life simpler and more rewarding for the people who bank with us, the team members who work with us and the communities we’re proud to support. Joining ING means stepping into an environment where your individuality isn’t just welcomed \- it’s celebrated. We’ve built a culture that’s fun, inclusive and supportive, giving you the freedom to be yourself, so you can ‘do your thing’.


Whether you’re taking ownership of exciting projects, thinking outside the box, or working with global colleagues, you’ll find ING is the kind of place where growth isn’t just a possibility; it’s a promise. As a WGEA Employer of Choice for Gender Equality and Family Inclusive workplace, you’ll feel the difference in how we value and champion our people.


We make hiring decisions based on your skills, capabilities, and how you align with our values \- not on ticking every box. So, if you’re interested but don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply. We’re invested in fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels like they belong. We’re your allies in helping you do your thing during the recruitment process, so let us know (email below) if you require any support or adjustments when you apply


Sound like your kind of vibe? We can’t wait to hear from you!


(One last note: We operate using a direct talent sourcing model, so no agency introductions, please.)


ING is Australia’s most recommended bank according to RFI Global’s Consumer Atlas Survey, January–June 2025 (n \= 29,510\) when compared to customers of the 10 largest ADIs operating in Australia.


Need more?

  

  

Contact: Skye Griffiths on skye.griffiths@ing.com


For support and adjustments, including DEI, LGBTQI\+ confidential application support enquiries: rpoteam.au@ing.com


**Applications close Friday 21 August**
